name: Fortune Brands Innovations
plan: NO POSITION. NO BLIND ENTRY - prints 2026-08-04 post-market (tomorrow). Re-open only on a FY26 guide reset AND price below $36 AND two consecutive quarters of positive organic revenue.
catalyst: Q2 2026 print 2026-08-04 post-market (verified). Consensus $0.824 EPS on a $0.75-$1.17 range across 16 analysts - a 56% spread; the sell side does not know what the quarter looks like, and a first-quarter-in-seat CEO has every incentive to reset.
kill_triggers: FY26 revenue declines again in FY27 guidance
new CEO resets FY26 EPS below $2.90
edge_explainer: The queue asked for a value-trap test on the -1.9% rev3y and the test returns TRAP on every leg. Revenue: FY26 consensus -1.8% ($4.464bn -> $4.384bn). Estimates: FY26 EPS $3.395 -> $3.120 (-8.1%) and FY27 $3.903 -> $3.646 (-6.6%) over 90 days, near-quarter -16.8%, with 14-15 down and 0 up revisions in 30 days - the definition of derailment, estimates falling and the multiple following. Quality: 6.5% GAAP operating margin on a 44.9% gross margin, ttm earnings -52.4%. Balance sheet: ~$2.74bn net debt on $811M EBITDA = ~3.4x into a housing trough. Management: new CEO appointed July 2026. Path is the worst combination in the cohort: the stock gapped -17.6% on 2026-02-13 (the derailment event), bottomed at $32.34 on 05-19, and is now +61.3% off that low at $52.17 - it has round-tripped the entire gap-down back to the pre-crash level while the estimates sit 8% lower than they were 90 days ago. The price has un-priced the bad news; the analysts have not.
top_unverifiable: Leverage is vendor-sourced, not filing-verified. The ~3.4x net-leverage figure carrying the balance-sheet leg was not pulled from the 10-Q; direction is not in doubt but the multiple and covenant headroom are unverified. Secondarily, the 'conservative accounting understates true cash earnings' bull argument was not tested against the cash-flow statement.
screen_defect: Proposed feature - flag when price has recovered >=80% of a derailment gap-down while FY estimates remain >=5% below their pre-gap level. Cleaner than '% off low' alone.
